basic_info.description: Beautifully renovated single family home sitting high on the hill with brilliant natural light, lovely Cole Valley and Forest views, and sublime walk out garden with stone patio and stunning rear garden landscape. The home is perfectly designed   with 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, plus family room laid out over two living levels. There is a gorgeous new chef's kitchen, formal dining room, and expansive living room with fireplace plus verdant Tank Hill views and Juliette balcony. The next owner will really enjoy the impressive Indoor/Outdoor living components : walk out rear patio and lush flowering garden bursting with color. Two fully updated and tiled baths, and a rebuilt laundry room compliment this idyllic floor plan. There is a Separate 1 car garage plus the ability to park a second car in the street , in front of the garage. A truly exceptional value just a short walk to Cole Street, the museums and gardens of Golden Gate Park, and the hiking/biking trails of Mt Sutro.
